limitations: Original run manifests, owned runtimes, archived INI files and native-preflight proofs were not supplied. Reconstructed descriptors establish declaration compatibility, not original execution provenance.
The journals report Fairy-Stockfish 230826 and its executable hash. This offline review does not independently inspect that executable or attest its native value tables.
Every forced opening and stored opening FEN is independently replayed with the frozen browser rules. Full game continuations and their reported outcomes are not independently replayed.

The thirty-two related fixed opening cases, forced-prefix protocol and fixed search priors limit generalization. Conditional ranges do not include engine or protocol bias; scores are not material values.
The selected designs reflect the user's preference for movement identity and readability. The results do not establish exact balance or justify changing any recorded score.

sources.policy: Preserve each accepted body's tested applied MG/EG prior or exact matched family anchor, applying it to all six engine tables for both colors. These are engine search settings, not material estimates or upgrade purchase points.

evaluationAudit.policy: Freeze shared family priors for each trial bracket: L1 queens 2771/2833, L2 pawns 536/592, L3 knight pawns 762/808 from Ranger. Herald control keeps 418/436; QgsQ0 Wraith keeps 3772/3470 from its historical Wraith anchor. Fixed references retain their tested values. All six engine tables and both colors are verified. Search priors are not measured material values or purchase prices.

report.openingPolicy: One shared eight-family book for all tiers, armies and colors. Each eight-case batch has one case from each structural family. All 64 ordinary positions are distinct after ignoring move clocks. Prefixes contain eight standard plies, preserve material and stop outside check; they are not chosen for near-zero upgraded-army evaluations. The complete book must pass ordinary-chess replay and actual-army legality before collection. Static tactical flags remain diagnostic and never silently remove cells. Related prefixes are not independent population samples.

notes: Only stored first-search diagnostics are read. No engine search, replay or historical backfill occurs.
Scores use White POV. A POV is derived from each game's recorded physical color. Mate scores and bounds are never averaged with exact centipawns.

Each diagnostic pair averages its two White-POV exact-cp scores with A's colors swapped. Opening rows summarize those pair averages; this is conditional color context, not a causal correction or proof of fairness.
Latest attempts count once. Diagnostic pairs may include truncated, aborted or error games because their opening search happened; game results and outcome-pair scoring remain unchanged.
Engine, profile, evaluation policy, evaluator strength and search-budget contexts remain separate. Missing legacy observations are explicit.
